_comment: 面容token只在此写一次，由build_story.py逐字注入。文本一致不是视觉同脸证明。少年永不露脸。
_casting_note: 全部为非本人容貌的虚构成年演员；C1波戈只是同一演员妆容变体。不继承北九州定妆照，不启用双图实验。

characters.name: 盖西/波戈同一虚构成年演员（非本人容貌）
characters.face: a fictional adult Midwestern man aged thirty-six, broad rounded face with a blunt square jaw and a small dimple on the left cheek, deep-set hazel eyes beneath thick straight brown eyebrows, a short broad nose, thin closed lips, short dark brown side-parted hair with slightly receding temples, clean-shaven fair skin; identical facial geometry in both everyday clothes and simple party clown makeup

characters.name: 母亲角色（虚构成年演员，非家属本人）
characters.face: a fictional adult Midwestern woman aged forty-four, a slender oval face with a narrow chin and high cheekbones, wide grey-green eyes beneath gently arched light eyebrows, a long narrow straight nose, a small softly downturned mouth, chestnut shoulder-length waved hair with a left part, pale freckled skin and faint fine lines at the outer eyes

characters.name: 办案警探（虚构成年演员，非真实警员）
characters.face: a fictional adult Midwestern detective aged fifty-three, a long angular face with a high broad forehead and deep forehead creases, small dark blue eyes behind square dark-rimmed glasses, thick greying eyebrows, a prominent hooked nose, a broad firm mouth, short iron-grey hair combed straight back, weathered ruddy skin and a neat grey moustache

characters.name: 法官角色（虚构成年演员，非真实法官）
characters.face: a fictional adult American judge aged sixty-two, a narrow triangular face with a pointed chin and hollow cheeks, calm dark brown almond-shaped eyes with heavy lids, sparse silver eyebrows, a fine straight nose, a small closed mouth, silver hair parted centrally and combed close to the scalp, warm olive skin with fine crow feet and a clean-shaven jaw
